tools.name: search_projects

Use it when the user describes a need or a kind of tool ("a self-hosted alternative to Notion", "a Rust terminal"), and with sort week or month for what is rising within that topic. tools.name: trending_projects
tools.description: The GitHub projects that gained the most stars on the last closed GitHub day, or over the last week or month, from GitHub.Locker's daily ranking. Use it when the user asks what is trending, hot or new on GitHub without naming a topic. For trending projects within a topic use search_projects with sor

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: One project from the GitHub.Locker catalog as markdown: what it is, questions and answers about it (platforms, install, pricing, privacy), stars, language and license, similar projects, its topics and the start of its README. Use it when the user names a specific repository or link, or to check a pr
